name: Securities Transaction Price 18 Choice
definition: Specifies the price of the securities transaction.

MonetaryValue.name: Monetary Value
MonetaryValue.definition: Indicates that price is expressed as a monetary value.

Percentage.name: Percentage
Percentage.definition: Indicates that price is expressed as a rate, that is a percentage.

Decimal.name: Decimal
Decimal.definition: Indicates that price is expressed as a decimal.

BasisPoints.name: Basis Points
BasisPoints.definition: Used to express differences in interest rates, for example, a difference of 0.10% is equivalent to a change of 10 basis points.
